speaker: Technician
text: Hey, courier. We're installing CCTV for the management. Which floors have blind spots?
choice_options: Tell the truth | Lie: say there are none | Say nothing

speaker: Technician
text: Funny. Nobody asked for cameras on the 4th floor. Only on the corridors of the delinquent kid.

speaker: Grocery Lady
text: Unit 202? Oh, it's haunted for sure. I hear it every night. Don't go near it.

speaker: Grocery Lady
text: ...Between us, I made half of it up. But people like a story. Who is going to check?

speaker: Honor Student
text: Delivery? Thanks. Say, how is he doing? You know... him. Upstairs. Does he look okay to you?
choice_options: Say he looks fine | Say he looks hurt | Say you do not know

speaker: Delinquent
text: Don't look at me like that. Everyone is watching me now. Even the walls.
choice_options: Ask if he is okay | Hand over the parcel and leave

speaker: Delinquent
text: They want me to stay quiet. It is easier when nobody believes me.
clue_given: Signs of tracking and psychological abuse

speaker: Fortune Teller
text: Sit. Room 202. Years ago a student was hurt there, and the adults chose not to see it. The same pattern is back.
choice_options: Ask who | Ask why nobody acted

speaker: Fortune Teller
text: The names were removed from the registry. Look at the old delivery manifests.

speaker: Rollers Lady
text: Thud, thud, thud. Right over my head, every second night. You do not believe me, do you?

speaker: Rollers Lady
text: Always after dark. Always the same rhythm. Like somebody practicing.
clue_given: Rhythmic thuds above every other night

speaker: Honor's Mother
text: My son does not take deliveries. He is busy. Studying. Please leave the parcel here.
choice_options: Insist on delivering to him | Leave it with her

speaker: Honor's Mother
text: He hides when the bell rings. I do not ask why. I... I am afraid of the answer.

speaker: Husband
text: We are leaving tonight. We can't take it anymore. You should leave too.
choice_options: Ask where they are going | Ask what they saw

speaker: Wife
text: Please do not write our names in your report. Please.
choice_options: Promise to protect them | Say you must report | Say nothing

speaker: Street Thug
text: You are close, courier. Fourth floor. The thing nobody wants you to see. I can get you in tomorrow.

speaker: Grocery Lady
text: The guard? He has a sweet tooth. Never says no to pastries.
clue_given: Lure step 1: the guard loves sweets

speaker: Chubby Lady
text: Pastries for the guard? Fine, I will bake. But I am out of flour and sugar.

speaker: Elderly Husband
text: Flour and sugar? Take it, dear. For the boy, I would give the whole kitchen.

speaker: Fortune Teller
text: Before nightfall tomorrow, someone will be gone for good. Make sure it is not the one you can still save.

speaker: Security Guard
text: Mmm... those pastries. Fine, five minutes. Do not touch anything.

speaker: Delinquent
text: You came back. I did not think anyone would.
choice_options: Open the door and take him out | Leave him there | Report him to the agency
clue_given: Sets delinquent_saved = true on the first option

speaker: Dispatcher
text: Final report. Be careful what you write. We read everything.
choice_options: File report (opens the report form) | Walk out
